title: Erasing the last tape cell
statement: For every Boolean word $\mathit{pre}$ and bit $b$, changing the tape that stores $\mathit{pre}$ followed by $b$ so that the cell at position $|\mathit{pre}|$ is blank yields exactly the tape that stores $\mathit{pre}$.
